prompt.project_info: Medium-shot four-person tropical beach group portrait adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Four clearly adult original women in casual summer beachwear: vibrant cobalt-blue, bright-yellow, crisp-white and black ribbed tank tops paired with light-wash high-waisted denim jeans or cargo-style denim pants, minimalist jewelry and natural summer hairstyles.
prompt.composition_elements: Tiered group composition on white sand: one woman in the foreground gives a peace sign and winks, another kneels in front smiling, and two stand behind smiling warmly; turquoise ocean, leaning coconut palms and clear pale-blue sky frame the group.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright side-lit golden-hour sunlight, soft warm highlights, natural shadows and glowing tropical summer atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: High-end digital-camera look, 35mm lens, f/2.8, 8K photorealism, sharp faces, softly blurred distant background, cinematic color grading; preserve correct fingers, separate limbs and physically plausible overlaps.
